title: Observability
equipment: Gravity tank cascade with a downstream sensor and diagnostic simulation truth
physicalPurpose: Recover upstream deviation from downstream level history and expose differentiation noise.
objective: Separate noiseless observability from useful noisy state estimation.

simplifications: Equal fixed cross sections and discharge coefficients; free upstream discharge without downstream backpressure.
Physical levels use coupled RK4 gravity balances; the ST predictor is a separate local one-second Euler approximation.

baseline.limitation: Noiseless observability does not establish useful reconstruction under noise.

change.decision: Compare RMSE and peak error; a one-step noise difference adds about.25m reconstruction error.

disturbances: Start h1=.27m,h2=.25m,q=.010m3/s; compare fresh clean and ±.005m alternating downstream measurement cases.

acceptance.window: clean case: valid estimates after first sample through20s
noisy case: valid estimates after first sample through20s

abortPredicates: Level outside .05–.45 m, requested flow outside0–.020 m3/s, invalid data or a non-one-second clock interval.
safety.restorationMode: Normal completion restores .010 m3/s; early abort commands zero and requires simulator stop/reset.
simulationOnlyRestrictions: The result is simulation evidence for this lesson model.

video.viewerOutcome: Separate noiseless observability from useful noisy state estimation.

learning.context: The local two-tank model is controllable, but only downstream level is measured.
learning.reason: Upstream storage affects the downstream measurement slope.
theory: C=[0,1] and CA=[.04,−.04] provide independent rows. Differentiation amplifies alternating sensor noise.
learning.workedPrediction: At y=0 and dy/dt=.0008m/s, y+25dy/dt=.02m. A.01m noise difference adds.25m through the derivative.
practicalPreparation: Use a fresh synchronized run at h1=.27m,h2=.25m; wait for two measured samples before estimating.
learning.baseline: Record clean downstream-history estimates without seeding upstream truth.
learning.change: Inspect C and CA in Control Studio, then implement and observe downstream-history reconstruction.
learning.validation: Report RMSE and peak error over EstimateReady samples only; keep simulation truth out of estimator inputs.
learning.explanation: Observability is information availability in measurement history, not guaranteed estimator performance in noise.
learning.transfer: State feedback chooses a pump law; a later observer supplies the hidden upstream state.
